read.thesis: Constellation raised FY26 adjusted EPS guidance to $11.50–$12.50 and contracted about 30% of clean baseload output, but supply-side evidence is thin: no new build capex, and no capacity addition beyond uprates and Crane restart.

utilisation.quote: Our nuclear fleet delivered a 93% capacity factor

capex.peers_comment: Dominguez said PJM's Connect and Manage program needs improvement and the bilateral process is confidential; no peer capacity commentary.
